title: Un linceul n'a pas de poches
writer: Horace McCoy, Jean-Pierre Mocky, Alain Moury
actors: Jean Carmet, Michel Constantin, Michel Galabru
plot: Michel Dolannes resigns from a major newspaper as a journalist to launch a new journal 'Le Cosmopolite' which reveals all kinds of shady deals. One day, he is killed but who is the killer?
